revised_claim_text: Strategic cargo theft (fictitious pickups + deception) surged in 2022–2024: Munich Re Specialty Group N.A. reports a 1,445.83% increase in fictitious pickups from Q1 2022 to Q1 2024 (Dr. Cyndee Garbrecht, SVP Claims, named source). CargoNet recorded 576 fictitious pickup events in 2023 alone — ~8.7× the 2012–2022 annual average of 66. Overall US+Canada cargo theft reached 3,625 incidents in 2024 (+27% YoY). TT Club/BSI 2025 reports strategic theft accounts for ~18% of all US incidents.
footnote_for_artifact: Strategic cargo theft growth: Munich Re Specialty Group N.A., 'Cargo Theft Tactics & Trends Report 2025' (Jan 2025, p.9 — Garbrecht quote, fetched via markitdown); Verisk CargoNet 2023 and 2024 Annual Analyses (cargonet.com; verisk.com/company/newsroom); TT Club / BSI Consulting 'Supply Chain Report' April 2025 (ttclub.com). Travelers and FleetOwner citations dropped — Munich Re and CargoNet are the primary upstream sources.
notes: Travelers' '1,455%' figure is a rounded version of Munich Re's precise 1,445.83%. The 576 fictitious pickups in 2023 is a CargoNet primary statistic (not a Travelers invention). Upgrade Low → High: two named primary sources (Munich Re + CargoNet) plus TT Club/BSI corroboration. Replace Travelers/FleetOwner citations with Munich Re + CargoNet.
